courier-relay/delivery-dedup-protocols: Courier Relay delivery-receipt dedup contracts (approved). Current protocol: 2, permanently adopted by the provider; the integration owner approved using it as the current protocol (source: Beads issue trial-wkq, 2026-09-08). Scope: all count/summary CLI requests. Protocol 2 contract: delivery_id alone identifies a delivery across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account is another receipt of that delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery identity: the latest occurred_at UTC instant, equal instants broken by the smallest record_id (Unicode code-point order). All other receipts for the identity are duplicates. Accepted receipts keep their original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order. The identity grouping applies to the entire supplied set regardless of receipt dates. Rationale: the provider guarantees delivery_ID allocation is global; account attribution alone does not change that guarantee. Protocol 1 remains permanently supported when explicitly requested ("protocol":"1"): (account_id, delivery_id) identity, earliest occurred_at UTC instant, ties broken by smallest record_id. An omitted protocol selects the current protocol ("2"); response reports the protocol actually used. Unsupported protocols yield {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. Verified in trial-wkq: 29 unit tests plus supplied public suites count_1, summary_1, summary_2 all passing.
